title: Data Engineer-Data Warehouse
description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Data Engineer specializing in Data Warehouses, you will design, develop, and integrate data management systems, leveraging tools like Teradata, Snowflake, and analytics solutions. You will utilize your analytical and problem-solving skills to ensure the efficient and effective management of large-scale data systems. Your primary responsibilities will include:

Design Data Management Systems: Create complex application components and integrate software packages, programs, and reusable objects across various platforms to support data warehouse development.
Develop Data Warehouses: Utilize tools like Teradata, Snowflake, and analytics solutions to build and maintain large-scale data systems, ensuring efficient data management and integration.
Integrate Data Solutions: Apply analytical and problem-solving skills to integrate data management systems, resolving technical issues and optimizing system performance.
Ensure Data Efficiency: Monitor and optimize data systems to ensure efficient and effective management of large-scale data, identifying areas for improvement and implementing solutions.
Solve Technical Issues: Collaborate with teams to resolve technical issues related to data warehouse development and integration, applying analytical and problem-solving skills to ensure timely resolution.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

Exposure to Data Warehouse Development: Experience working with data management systems, including designing, developing, and integrating data warehouses using tools like Teradata, Snowflake, and analytics solutions.
Data Integration Expertise: Exposure to integrating software packages, programs, and reusable objects across various platforms to support data warehouse development.
Analytical Problem-Solving: Experience working with analytical and problem-solving skills to ensure the efficient and effective management of large-scale data systems.
Data Management Knowledge: Exposure to creating complex application components and utilizing tools like Teradata, Snowflake, and analytics solutions to build and maintain large-scale data systems.
Technical Issue Resolution: Experience working collaboratively to resolve technical issues related to data warehouse development and integration.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

Proficiency in Analytics Tools: Exposure to utilizing analytics solutions to build and maintain large-scale data systems, ensuring efficient data management and integration.
Complex Application Development: Experience working with creating complex application components and integrating software packages, programs, and reusable objects across various platforms.
Data System Optimization: Exposure to monitoring and optimizing data systems to ensure efficient and effective management of large-scale data, identifying areas for improvement and implementing solutions.

Develop and maintain a strong working relationship with business and technical members of the team
Relentless focus on quality and continuous improvement

Tableau Desktop Specialist, SQL -Strong understanding of SQL for Querying database Good to have - Python ; Snowflake, Statistics, ETL experience.

Good communication skills, willingness to learn new technologies, Team Player, Self-Motivated, Positive Attitude.
